title: Hybrid Six-Level Rydberg Atomic Quantum Receiver for Multi-Band Wireless Communications
summary: Rydberg atomic quantum receivers (RAQRs) have recently emerged as a promising technology for radio-frequency (RF) reception by directly transducing incident RF fields into optical signals. Existing receiver architectures, however, exploit only subsets of the dipole-allowed transitions within a given atomic manifold, limiting the number of simultaneously accessible RF channels. In this paper, a hybrid six-level Rydberg atomic quantum receiver (H-RAQR) is proposed by integrating parallel and cascaded RF coupling pathways within a single vapor-cell receiver.
